#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>

int main() {
    long long x, n, a, y, b;
    std::cin >> x >> y >> n;
    
    double minDiff = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
    long long bestA = 0, bestB = 0;
    
    for (b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
        a = (x * b) / y;
        
        // Check exact matches first
        if (a > 0 && x * b == (a - 1) * y) {
            std::cout << (a - 1) << "/" << b << std::endl;
            return 0;
        }
        if (x * b == a * y) {
            std::cout << a << "/" << b << std::endl;
            return 0;
        }
        if (x * b == (a + 1) * y) {
            std::cout << (a + 1) << "/" << b << std::endl;
            return 0;
        }
        
        // Update best approximation
        if (a > 0) {
            double diff1 = std::abs(static_cast<double>(x * b - (a - 1) * y) / (y * b));
            if (diff1 < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diff1;
                bestA = a - 1;
                bestB = b;
            }
        }
        
        double diff2 = std::abs(static_cast<double>(x * b - a * y) / (y * b));
        if (diff2 < minDiff) {
            minDiff = diff2;
            bestA = a;
            bestB = b;
        }
        
        double diff3 = std::abs(static_cast<double>(x * b - (a + 1) * y) / (y * b));
        if (diff3 < minDiff) {
            minDiff = diff3;
            bestA = a + 1;
            bestB = b;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << bestA << "/" << bestB << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
